sections.title: key findings — final regular season standings

insights.content: DTC #1 finishes 7-3 and holds the head-to-head tiebreak over Dragonridge (won 3-2 on 4/25) — making DTC #1 the 2nd seed from 3.5B if USTA applies head-to-head first. Dragonridge also finished 7-3 but lost on the final day (2-3 to Desert Palm), while DTC #1 was already done. The head-to-head split puts DTC #1 above Dragonridge in the standings.

Red Rock CC #2 wins Sub B at 10-0 — the best record in 3.5 by a wide margin. DTC #1 and Dragonridge are both 7-3. Head-to-head: DTC #1 won the only matchup 3-2 (4/25). Line record: Dragonridge leads 36-14 vs DTC #1's 30-20. The tiebreaker that applies first determines seeding — head-to-head gives DTC #1 the 2nd seed.

Dragonridge lost 2-3 to Desert Palm in W11 despite being a heavy favorite. Maria Allen (their best player, r=3.32) lost S1 to Amanda Verba 6-4 6-2. They won only D2 and D3. This could be load management before playoffs — or it could reflect real vulnerabilities against aggressive baseliners. Worth noting before any potential playoff matchup.

DTC #2 wins Sub A at 9-1 and enters as the overall 3.5 top seed. LTF is 2nd at 7-3. The Sub A bracket produces DTC #2 and LTF as the advancing teams. DTC #2 is the strongest team in either subflight on paper.

Stacie Corelle (bl=3.41, r=3.51, 6-1) is the backbone — high record, high rating, battle-tested. Karen Kiyono (bl=3.33, r=3.41, 6-2) is the team's biggest riser and most reliable doubles contributor. Hernandez/Kiyono won D1 in the decisive W10 match. These two anchor the playoff lineup.

Amy Waters (bl=3.66, r=3.43, 3-3) is down 0.23 from baseline and dropped lines in two of DTC #1's three losses. Allen (bl=3.68, r=3.57, 4-1) and Drees (bl=3.57, r=3.62, 4-2) are both above baseline. Waters needs a different doubles partner or a clean return to form — pairing her under pressure at D1 against playoff-quality teams is a risk.

sections.title: playoff outlook — DTC #1 likely 2nd seed from 3.5B

insights.content: DTC #1 enters playoffs as 2nd seed from Sub B (pending tiebreak confirmation). Four teams advance: Sub B — Red Rock CC #2 (1st, 10-0) and DTC #1 (2nd, 7-3); Sub A — DTC #2 (1st, 9-1) and LTF (2nd, 7-3). The bracket likely puts DTC #1 vs LTF or DTC #2 in the first round — both are winnable.

Lead with Corelle at S1 — 6-1 record is the best on the team. Allen/Drees at D1 gives the strongest individual ratings. Kiyono in every doubles lineup she can play. Consider Curtis or Hernandez pairing with Waters at D2 rather than leaning on Waters at D1 — let her rebuild confidence at a lower-pressure line first.

Red Rock CC #2 (10-0) is the bracket favorite and has dominated all season — MacDonald (3.72), Chamberlain (3.71), Toft (3.56), Watts (3.58), Lind (3.59), Hale (3.57). Six players above 3.56. Avoiding them until the final is the best case scenario. If DTC #1 gets to the final, it's going to be Red Rock — so the goal is to win the semi clean and arrive healthy.
